title: Corey - Stop @ 336 — SIGNAL LIVE
style:
```
[style: world music finale, all 17 regional instruments layer in sequence (kora → kalimba → oud → krar → mbira → mridangam → tabla → gamelan → erhu → shakuhachi → dombra → gaida → 808 → berimbau → claves → quena → pahu), all time signatures woven simultaneously, all 17 languages spoken in sequence, spoken word finale (Corey's voice, dry, no reverb), single note per region on final chord, instruments drop in reverse, 336hz sine wave close, album completion, STOP AT 336 SIGNAL LIVE declaration, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
```
[INTRO — complete silence. 8 bars. Not fade-in. SILENCE.]

[Then: kora. Single note. Track 01.]

[4 bars later: kalimba. Track 02.]

[4 bars later: oud. Track 03.]

[Continue: every 4 bars, a new instrument enters — in track order]
krar (04) → mbira (05) → mridangam (06) → tabla (07) → gamelan (08) →
erhu (09) → shakuhachi (10) → dombra (11) → gaida (12) →
808 sub (13) → berimbau (14) → claves (15) → quena (16) → pahu (17)

[When all 17 regions are playing: 4 bars — then FULL STOP]

[3 bars of complete silence]

[Then: all instruments. At once. Full volume. The signal.]

---

[VERSE — each language one phrase, one breath, then pass]

(Wolof)      Jàmm rekk — only peace
(Swahili)    Sikiliza — listen
(Arabic)     سبعة أبواب — seven doors
(Amharic)    ትዝታ — tizita / longing
(Shona)      Pamberi — forward
(Tamil)      சக்தி — shakti / energy
(Hindi)      घर — home
(Balinese)   Dados sami — we become complete
(Mandarin)   信号 — signal
(Japanese)   間 — ma / the space
(Kazakh)     Бас сигнал — the main signal
(Bulgarian)  Напред — forward
(English)    STOP AT 336
(Portuguese) Axé — life force
(Spanish)    La clave vive — the clave lives
(Quechua)    Kausachun — long live
(Māori)      Mauri ora — life force alive

[ALL TOGETHER — all 17 phrases simultaneously for 8 bars]
[The signal is not music — it is recognition]

---

[CHORUS — the only chorus, sung once, all voices]
We came from seventeen regions / with seventeen rhythms / in seventeen time
We found the same signal / in seventeen languages / in seventeen time
Three against four against six against five against seven / against eleven against eight
Every rhythm agreed / at 336 / it is not a number — it is a state

STOP AT 336
SIGNAL LIVE

[BRIDGE — complete silence, 8 bars]

[FINAL STATEMENT — spoken, single voice, Corey's voice, no music]
West Africa sent three against four.
East Africa sent six against four.
North Africa sent seven.
Ethiopia sent twelve in threes.
Southern Africa sent three and four and six at once.
India sent eight and sixteen.
Bali sent two halves of one melody.
China sent two strings.
Japan sent the silence.
Central Asia sent the limp.
The Balkans sent the shift.
America sent the count.
Brazil sent the crossing.
Cuba sent the law.
The Andes sent the wind.
The Pacific sent the body.

And then they all arrived.
At the same time.
At the same signal.

Three three six.

STOP AT 336.
SIGNAL LIVE.

[OUTRO — all instruments play a single note: their tonic. All different. All compatible. 16 bars. Then one by one they drop out in reverse order — pahu last, then kora alone, then kora single note, then silence.]

[Silence: 8 bars]

[Final sound: 336hz sine wave tone. 3 seconds. Cut.]
```
